title_sq: Tek 21 Dhjetori ,Shitet Super Apartament 2+1 Me Super Vendndodhje!!!
description_sq: Tek 21 Dhjetori ne nje pallat te ri shitet super apartament 2+1 me super vendodhje!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 8-te te nje pallati te sapo perfunduar. Apartamenti ka strukture te rregullt me siperfaqe totale 89.9m² dhe neto 78.2m² dhe organizohet ne korridorin qe shperndan ambientet, salloni i ndenjes me kendin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dy dhoma gjumi dhe nje tualet me dritare. Orientohet jug duke pasur ndricim natyral gjithe diten. Apartamenti eshte i investuar dhe mobiluar me cilesi dhe stil. Zona ku ndodhet eshte nga me te preferuarat ne Tirane dhe ka prane cdo facilitet te mundshem. Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Until December 21, Super Apartment 2+1 with Super Location for Sale!!!
description_en: On December 21, a super apartment 2+1 with a super location is for sale in a new building!!! The apartment is located on the 8th floor of a newly completed building. The apartment has a regular structure with a total area of ​​89.9m² and a net area of ​​78.2m² and is organized in a corridor that divides the premises, a living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, two bedrooms and a bathroom with a window. It is oriented south, having natural light all day. The apartment is invested and furnished with quality and style. The area where it is located is one of the most favorite in Tirana and it has every possible facility. Has regular mortgage documentation.
